qualification.selection: unique F own-Loss best only; no Q reselect; no phase switch by Q
qualification.panel: same fixed v6 dev_monitor500 and same E90 flash parameters; dev2000 draft corroboration
qualification.interpretation: Exploratory engineering near-parity: Loss within2%, weightedQ tolerance+.001; maxQ+5%, coverage pass-2pp and worst coverage p95+3pp guards. Report worker-paired uncertainty; passing a point tolerance does not prove statistical equivalence. Tolerances must not change after seeing new terminal.
qualification.if_fail: Stop all new work in this task, preserve evidence, close heartbeat; do not start corrector or retrain to chase Q
qualification.if_pass: Freeze qualified layout model/hash/data/config, then begin corrector design and registered training

final_target.quality_basis: same fixed development panel neutral runtime; not official unseen contest score
